  - When the text column would get narrower than about 14rem, the trailing action (e.g. 이전 AI 결과) moves down under the text instead of squeezing it.
- **`PostsPage.tsx` and `ClipsPage.tsx`:**
  - A running job's progress or a failure message now wraps and is shown in full.
  - Long 말투, template and tag names still shorten with "…", each on its own.

**Tests added:**
- `WorkRow.test.tsx` checks that the meta line wraps rather than clips, and that the action can drop below the text.
- The post-list failure test now covers the reviewer's case: the newest unfinished post has a failure, the "내보내기 가능" label, "이어서" and an 이전 AI 결과 link all at once. It checks the failure text is present and set to wrap, not shorten.

**Checks run from `frontend/`:**
- `npx tsc -b`, ESLint and Prettier on the changed files, `node ../scripts/lint-style-escapes.mjs` and `npx steiger ./src` all pass.
- Affected test suites pass: the row, 글 and 영상 lists, the work-list widget, ClipPage, Library, and the router/navigation tests (243 tests).
- The full `npx vitest run` passes end to end: 648 files, 5203 tests.

The task result in `spec/tasks/T903.work-row-lists.md` records the correction, the evidence and this limit.

**Limit:** the test environment does not compute layout, so the tests only confirm the wrapping is set up, not how the rows actually look at 320–390 px with Korean or long English labels.

dispatch.summary:
I fixed review correction 512904e3. On a narrow phone the work row no longer cuts off the status badge, the progress line or the failure explanation. Screenshots of the corrected rows on a real screen are still the coordinator's to take.

**What was wrong:** the meta line (the second line of each row) was clipped to one line. The status badge, the "내보내기 가능" label, the "이어서" cue and the trailing action never shrank, so the failure or progress text was the part that got cut.

**What changed:**
- **`WorkRow.tsx` (shared row):**
  - The meta line now wraps onto more lines instead of clipping.
  - When the text column would get narrower than about 14rem, the trailing action (e.g. 이전 AI 결과) moves down under the text instead of squeezing it.
- **`PostsPage.tsx` and `ClipsPage.tsx`:**
  - A running job's progress or a failure message now wraps and is shown in full.
  - Long 말투, template and tag names still shorten with "…", each on its own.

**Tests added:**
- `WorkRow.test.tsx` checks that the meta line wraps rather than clips, and that the action can drop below the text.
- The post-list failure test now covers the reviewer's case: the newest unfinished post has a failure, the "내보내기 가능" label, "이어서" and an 이전 AI 결과 link all at once. It checks the failure text is present and set to wrap, not shorten.

**Checks run from `frontend/`:**
- `npx tsc -b`, ESLint and Prettier on the changed files, `node ../scripts/lint-style-escapes.mjs` and `npx steiger ./src` all pass.
- Affected test suites pass: the row, 글 and 영상 lists, the work-list widget, ClipPage, Library, and the router/navigation tests (243 tests).
- The full `npx vitest run` passes end to end: 648 files, 5203 tests.

The task result in `spec/tasks/T903.work-row-lists.md` records the correction, the evidence and this limit.

**Limit:** the test environment does not compute layout, so the tests only confirm the wrapping is set up, not how the rows actually look at 320–390 px with Korean or long English labels.

I fixed the review finding: deleting a video template from its reading now sends keyboard focus to the directory instead of dropping it on the page body. Static checks and the full FE suite pass after the fix.

- **Before:** confirming 삭제 on `/video-templates/<id>` removed the delete button and navigated to the list, so focus fell to the document body.
- **Now:** the reading hands focus to the list on delete. Once the list is ready, focus lands on the first remaining tile, or on `+ 새 템플릿` when no template is left or the list can't be read. A normal visit to the list moves no focus.
- **How:** the reading and list pages can't import each other, so the handoff lives in the shared `widgets/template-directory` slice. It is one-shot and expires after `REMOVAL_FOCUS_HANDOFF_TTL_MS` (5000 ms, kept in the widget's config).

Tests: `TemplateDirectoryFocus.test.tsx` now checks both keyboard paths by name (deleting Middle lands on the First tile; deleting the last template lands on `새 템플릿`) and that a normal visit takes no focus. With the handoff call removed, the two focus tests fail; with it, they pass.

Checks, run from `frontend/`:
- `npx tsc -b`, ESLint and Prettier on the 7 changed files, `node ../scripts/lint-style-escapes.mjs` and `npx steiger ./src` all pass.
- Full `npx vitest run`: 647 files, 5207 tests passed (470 s).

These were run directly rather than through `vibe check`, because the last `vibe check` run was cut off by the 10-minute background limit. The task result records this round.

Left open:
- The post template's reading (`pages/template`, outside this task's scope) still deletes and navigates to `/templates` without a focus handoff. It can reuse the widget's handoff in a later task.
- The screenshot check (390×844 and 1280×900, day and night) is still for the coordinator on the integrated candidate.
